Today marks the official start of the **E-Motioner-X-SBS** research organization. This organization will house all thesis research, including work on biomolecular Hamiltonians, contact mapping, and machine learning models for protein folding.

## What's Next

- Setting up the thesis LaTeX repository
- Organizing literature review
- Building the first Hamiltonian computation pipeline
- Training initial protein folding models

Stay tuned for regular updates on research progress.
